search_window.basis: Prior completed hourly watch ended 2026-10-17 14:46:46 PDT. The time recorded as scheduled_for is the automation trigger timestamp; no distinct scheduled fire timestamp was supplied.

targeted_miss_classes: Closure or disaster affecting the only, sole, last or full-service grocery store
Abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or major access reduction
New official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate consequences
coverage_notes.query_context: Twelve targeted searches against October 17, 2026 reports, including fresh local news and agency/provider sources; results checked for events newly published since preceding hourly watch.
excluded_examples: Cape Girardeau, MO last-grocery-store loss: October 17 local roundup discusses older loss and a grant, not a newly occurring closure.
Kenosha County Food Bank: previous-week report describes a planned end-of-2026 shutdown, not an abrupt new disruption.
Prodisee Pantry storm cancellation concerns October 10 distribution, reported October 7.
Official October 2026 SNAP/WIC information located describes continuing benefits, not an interruption.
coverage_notes.coverage_limitations: Search index lag and undated notices mean absence of verified new findings does not establish absence of disruptions. This is a bounded supplemental watch, not the primary nationwide collector.
